summary: Session 2026-11-05 (pre-open). Wednesday close: SPY +1.77%, QQQ +1.13%, DIA +3.1%, XLK only +0.24%, energy -5% and oil -8%. The rally was broad and rotational, with consumer, staples, financials and health care leading. Tech lagged. Quotes at the close: NOW 110.06 (+0.8%), FTNT 129.5, INTC 58.1 (-4%), GOOGL 291 (+4%), RDDT 101 (+5%), UBER 70.4 (+5.7%, so the drift-short idea failed), AAPL 352.5 (+6.2%), DUOL +26% on earnings. I held the 5% NOW long unchanged (stop 101.37, target 129.22, horizon ends 2026-11-20). It is roughly flat. I found no new catalyst I could verify, and the earnings gaps are priced in at the open, so I made no new trades. I did not do deeper web research this session. Next session: check whether NOW holds 106-110 and whether software follows the broad rally. Look for post-event drift candidates, for example Upstart's guide cut and any names that gap down and keep falling. Watch whether energy weakness continues as oil falls.
